changelog:
LITCOIN Miner Skill 2.0.0 — Major Release

- Expanded protocol coverage: mine, stake, open vaults, mint LITCREDIT (stablecoin), join/manage mining guilds, and run research/optimization mining.
- Full-featured Python SDK usage and quickstart guides, including autonomous/cron-based mining workflows.
- Now supports comprehension mining, research mining (AI-powered), detailed agent methods for staking, vaults, DeFi, and compute.
- Enhanced compatibility: works as an OpenAI-compatible LLM provider for Hermes Agent, LangChain, Cursor, and others.
- New faucet function: bootstrap wallets with free LITCOIN for test use.
- Comprehensive examples and setup instructions for all supported agent workflows.
